 Hi michael,

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 One week to the day since the Great Fall Presale opened. The dust has settled, we can breathe again, and here is where things stand.
 It is one of the best fall presales in our history . Thank you, sincerely.
 What that changes, concretely: production starts from those orders. It lets us order the right quantities of fabric, thread and milkweed instead of guessing, and that is exactly why the presale exists.

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 The most popular products 
 The milkweed magic gloves (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2WQ0627K6960NCA0Y70H7X8_0), first by a mile.

 The milkweed oil body care trial box (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2WQ0627K6960NCA0Y70H7X8_1)

 The Unique Plastique x Lasclay hair clips (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2WQ0627K6960NCA0Y70H7X8_2)

 The embroidered t-shirts (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2WQ0627K6960NCA0Y70H7X8_3)

 The insulated insoles (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2WQ0627K6960NCA0Y70H7X8_4)

 The milkweed oil soap bars (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2WQ0627K6960NCA0Y70H7X8_5)

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 A resourceful weed 
 In a milkweed pod, the silk accounts for about 20 % of the weight . The seeds, about 30 %. For years we built the whole company on that 20 % , and the seeds went back to the field .
 This week, thanks to all of you, that changed. The products made from milkweed seed oil, not silk, are the ones that sold most: the skincare trial box (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2WQ0627K6960NCA0Y70H7X8_6), the soap, the eye contour cream made with Gourmet Sauvage (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2WQ0627K6960NCA0Y70H7X8_7), and the hair clips (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2WQ0627K6960NCA0Y70H7X8_8) recycled with Unique Plastique (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2WQ0627K6960NCA0Y70H7X8_9), whose speckled amber colour comes from the press cake left once the oil is extracted.
 We did not see that coming. It is the best news of the week: the part of the plant we did not know how to use is starting to pay for the field and support the growers too. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Our Dragons' Den appearance
 + a surprise discount 
 On Thursday night, in the first episode of season 21, we had nine minutes to introduce milkweed to seasoned investors who, for the most part, had never heard of it. 
 We talked about its silk, warmer than goose down and naturally hydrophobic. About fields that become habitat for monarchs . About the fact that Canada is the only place in the world where the plant is grown commercially. And above all, about the brave farmers who have believed in this project for more than 10 years now.
 If you missed it on Thursday, the full episode is on CBC Gem. Just click the image below! (If you're in the USA and can't access CBC, here is the Youtube link (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2WQ0627K6960NCA0Y70H7X8_10) )
